dataset: Weather Forecast API – current conditions for major world cities
description: Current temperature, precipitation and wind for about 150 major cities worldwide, taken from the best-matching national weather model as served by the Open-Meteo Forecast API. Modelled values, not station observations.

coverage.geographic: Global, sampled at a fixed list of 157 large cities and national capitals (cities.json, derived from Natural Earth populated places, public domain).
coverage.temporal: Current conditions only (15-minute model time step at fetch time).

updateCadence.upstream: Model data refresh every 1–6 hours depending on the model; current values are interpolated to 15 minutes

license.name: CC BY 4.0 – free API tier for non-commercial use only
license.notes: Open-Meteo terms (https://open-meteo.com/en/terms): the free API may be used for non-commercial purposes only, with fewer than 10,000 API calls per day, 5,000 per hour and 600 per minute; a request for several locations is counted as one call per location (observed header X-RateLimit-Cost: 100 for 100 locations). This adapter makes 2 requests (157 location-calls) every 3 hours, about 1,260 calls per day. Commercial deployments need a paid Open-Meteo subscription or a self-hosted instance. A link to open-meteo.com must be shown wherever the data are displayed. Underlying model data come from national weather services under their own open licences.

limitations: Values are numerical-weather-model output for the model grid cell containing the city (a few kilometres across), not measurements from a weather station; local conditions can differ, especially in mountainous or coastal cities.
Only a fixed sample of 157 cities is polled, so the layers are a global overview, not a weather map; severe weather between sampled cities is not shown.
Polled every 3 hours to stay well within the free tier's daily call limit, so values can be up to about 3 hours old.
Precipitation is the model sum over the preceding 15 minutes; the precipitation and wind layers only contain cities that currently exceed their thresholds.
confidenceNotes: No confidence value is given: Open-Meteo does not publish an uncertainty for current conditions. The wind layer's severity is derived by this application from the gust speed (≥50 km/h minor, ≥75 moderate, ≥90 severe, ≥118 extreme); it is not an official warning level.

retention.note: One record per city and layer, updated in place at every poll; records are purged 2 days after their last observation time.

layers.name: Temperature – major cities
layers.description: Current modelled 2 m air temperature for about 150 major cities (Open-Meteo).

layers.name: Precipitation – major cities
layers.description: Major cities where the model currently shows precipitation (sum over the preceding 15 minutes).

layers.name: Strong wind – major cities
layers.description: Major cities with modelled gusts of at least 50 km/h or sustained wind of at least 40 km/h.
